items.name: Gemini 4 Neon
items.plain: A faster top-tier AI assistant for demanding coding and analysis work, now available in Google's paid AI plans.
items.summary: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon on 18 November, a new Gemini 4 model that sits between Hydrogen and Carbon, offering frontier-level reasoning for complex coding, analytical and enterprise work at Flash-like speeds. It is rolling out in the Gemini app for AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and is generally available on the paid Gemini API.

items.name: GPT-6.2 Astra
items.plain: OpenAI's most capable model for demanding professional and scientific work, now cheaper for businesses to run.
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra on 17 November, its new frontier model for the hardest professional and scientific work, with stronger document, spreadsheet and coding output and API prices cut 20% versus GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI rates it at Critical cyber capability under its Preparedness Framework and shipped it with tighter safeguards for higher-risk security assistance.

items.name: GPT-6.2 Sol
items.plain: A fast, affordable everyday AI for drafting, coding and multi-step tasks, built for routine business use.
items.summary: OpenAI also released GPT-6.2 Sol on 17 November, an efficient everyday model for multistep agentic workflows, coding and writing that nearly matches Astra on real-code tasks at about a fifth of the cost. It is available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users, and in the API.

items.name: Qwen4-Max
items.plain: Alibaba's most capable AI for coding, research and long-running agent work, available as a low-cost cloud service.
items.summary: Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max on 16 November, its flagship multimodal model with native vision and a one-million-token context window, available API-only through QwenCloud. Alibaba claims it cuts average task cost by about 60% versus its predecessor while adding stronger safeguards against offensive cybersecurity use.

items.name: Tencent Hy4 Flash
items.plain: A budget-friendly AI model for coding and professional work, aimed at teams that need capable AI at low cost.
items.summary: Tencent launched Hy4 Flash on 16 November, a lower-cost version of its Hy4 model aimed at coding, professional work and scientific research, with image understanding, structured output and function calling. It is listed in Tencent Cloud's API guide with a one-million-token context window.
